익스트라라이트(Extralite)는 1995년 이탈리아에서 시작한 초경량: Extralite is an ultralight racing parts brand founded in Italy in 1995. The company is Studio Riva, led by Sergio Riva. Its first goal was a full-suspension mountain bike frameset under 2kg, rear hydraulic shock included.
그 프레임에 맞는 부품을 하나씩 만들다 보니 스템, 허브, 크랭크, 휠까: Building parts to suit that frame, one by one, the range grew to stems, hubs, cranks and wheels, and by the late 1990s Extralite had completed a full-suspension bike under 8kg. Every product is still designed, machined and assembled in northern Italy.

No frills, just substance.
Materials and machining over decoration.
익스트라라이트는 연구 비용을 좋은 소재와 가공 설비에 몰아 씁니다. 대형: Extralite puts its research money into the best materials and machining equipment. Parts cut on large multi-axis CNC machines are assembled one at a time by Italian technicians with prototype-level care, and weights are published honestly. The part you receive may even be lighter than listed.
가벼운 만큼 시험은 길게 합니다. HyperStem은 몇 달 동안 피로: The lighter the part, the longer the testing. HyperStem went through months of fatigue testing and exceeded the standard by a factor of four, so it is recommended even for enduro. Most parts made since 1995 can still be serviced with spare parts and restoration.
HyperStem 한 개를 마작(Mazak) 다축 머신으로 한 시간 넘게: Each HyperStem is 3D machined for over an hour on a Mazak multi-axis machine. Even the surfaces are machined smooth to reduce stress concentrations.
주요 제품은 UNI · EN 기준을 넘는 피로 시험을 거칩니다. QRC-: Key products are fatigue tested beyond UNI and EN standards. QRC-3 cranks are 17% lighter and 15% stiffer than the previous generation.
허브 베어링 예압을 바깥에서 돌려 맞추는 마이크로 튜너. 베어링은 ABI: The micro-tuner sets hub bearing preload from the outside. Bearings range from ABI-Enduro steel to HyperCeramic and XD-15 ceramic.
볼트 한 개, 폴 한 개까지 교체 부품을 따로 공급합니다. 가볍게 만들되: Spare parts are supplied down to a single bolt or pawl. Built light, and built to be serviced for years.
스템과 허브는 블랙이 기본. 크랭크, 브롬톤 허브, 브레이크 레버는 제품: Stems and hubs come in black as standard. Colour options for cranks, Brompton hubs and brake levers vary by product
Not one part,
but the whole bike.
익스트라라이트는 프레임에서 출발한 회사라 부품을 따로 떼어 보지 않습니다: Extralite started with a frame, so it never looks at a part in isolation. Stems have rounded clamp edges and lower recommended torque to protect carbon bars and steerers, and hubs have flanges and spoke holes designed around the spokes and rims of the finished wheel.
무게를 덜어 가속과 오르막, 방향 전환을 가볍게 하되, 실제 레이스에서: Weight comes off for faster acceleration, climbing and handling, while the stiffness and durability needed for real racing stay. That is why cross-country racers have used Extralite parts for years.
From stems to frames, parts made lighter on the same principles.

HyperStem은 7075 알루미늄 블록을 다축 머신으로 한 시간 넘게: HyperStem is 3D machined from a 7075 aluminium block on a multi-axis machine for over an hour. The bolts are grade 5 titanium Torx with rounded heads, and every clamp edge is rounded to protect carbon bars and steerers. Recommended torque is 2Nm.
크로스컨트리, 엔듀로, 그래블, 로드까지. D형 스티어러라면 브레이크 호: Cross-country, enduro, gravel and road. With a D-shaped steerer, brake hoses and electronic shift wires can run through the stem.
1-1/4인치 스티어러를 위한 HyperStem. 블랙 위에 블랙으로 레: HyperStem for 1-1/4 inch steerers. Available only with stealth black-on-black laser etched graphics.
케이블을 스템 안으로 넣는 HyperStem. 구멍을 낸 자리마다 보강해: The HyperStem with internal cable routing. Every opening is reinforced to keep the original stiffness and weight. 9.8g AC-01 aero cover option.
3K 마감의 카본 플랫 바. 클램프 부분에 가로 섬유를 넣어 가벼운 스템: Carbon flat bar with a 3K finish. Transverse fibres in the clamp area let it work with a light stem.
버티드 알루미늄 튜브 위에 이음매 없이 짠 카본을 높은 압력으로 성형했습: Seamlessly woven carbon moulded at high pressure over a butted aluminium tube. Light and impact resistant, with a bar end compatible version.
HyperStem의 앞 클램프를 통째로 바꿔 끼우는 컴퓨터 마운트. 가민: A computer mount that replaces the HyperStem front clamp. Garmin and Wahoo adaptors, with an optional GoPro mount below.
그레이드5 티타늄 토크스, 블랙 PVD 코팅, 권장 토크 2Nm: Grade 5 titanium Torx, black PVD coated, recommended torque 2Nm
D형 · Y형 스티어러에서 브레이크 호스와 Di2 선 내장 가능 (D 평: Brake hoses and Di2 wires can run inside with D- or Y-shaped steerers (flat side of the D up to 26mm)

Hyper, for mountain and gravel, uses an all-alloy front-engagement freehub to handle high torque and mud, a thick 17mm axle and external seals. Cyber, for the road, saves weight with a titanium ratchet, two pawls and four bearings.
두 계열 모두 마이크로 튜너로 베어링 예압을 바깥에서 맞춥니다. 베어링은: Both families set bearing preload from the outside with the micro-tuner. Bearings range from standard ABI-Enduro steel to stainless, HyperCeramic and Enduro XD-15 ceramic.
3세대 시스템. 떠 있는 링이 이전보다 약 20% 가벼워졌고, 허브 쉘의: Third-generation system. The floating ring is about 20% lighter, and a redesigned hub shell spline lasts over 35% longer.
프리허브에 따라 36 또는 48포인트. Hemi 프리허브는 시마노 9-4: 36 or 48 points depending on the freehub. The Hemi freehub takes Shimano 9-45T cassettes and Campagnolo N3W.
허브를 열지 않고 바깥에서 베어링 예압을 맞춥니다. 마찰은 낮게, 림의: Bearing preload is set from the outside without opening the hub. Low friction, no play at the rim.
스포크 구멍을 3D 각도로 가공하고 둥글려, 카본 스포크와 버드(Berd: Spoke holes are machined at 3D angles and rounded, so carbon spokes and Berd spokes fit directly without washers.

로드 디스크 허브셋. 스트레이트 풀 스포크로 스프린트 때 휠의 휨을 줄이: Road disc hubset. Straight-pull spokes reduce wheel flex when sprinting and transmit disc braking torque directly.

림 브레이크 로드 허브셋. 플랜지가 스포크 장력에 맞춰 스스로 정렬되고,: Rim brake road hubset. The flanges self-align under spoke tension, and the front hub can be laced radially.

같은 허브도 베어링에 따라 무게와 회전 감, 가격이 달라집니다. 기본은: The same hub changes weight, feel and price with its bearings. ABI-Enduro ABEC5 steel is standard, 440C stainless suits riders who see rain and sweat, and the smoothest, rust-free choices are HyperCeramic and Enduro XD-15 ceramic.

Sub-kilogram wheels,
built on our own hubs.

스포크는 카본, 버드(Berd) 섬유 스포크, 강철 중에 고릅니다. 가벼: Spokes can be carbon, Berd fibre or steel. Light rims reduce rotational inertia for quicker acceleration and changes of direction.

T1100 카본 림과 HyperSmart 3 허브의 그래블 휠셋. 니플: Gravel wheelset with T1100 carbon rims and HyperSmart 3 hubs. Every nipple hole is individually reinforced.

Machining once reserved for prototypes,
on every crank.
QRC 크랭크는 단면 안쪽을 비우고 응력이 지나는 길을 따라 두께를 나누: The QRC crank began with a design that hollows the section and distributes thickness along the stress path. Today's QRC-3 is 17% lighter and 15% stiffer than the previous generation. Each crankset spends hours on a five-axis machine with point-to-point 3D machining, the care once given only to prototypes.
Chainrings, bottom brackets, pulleys, quick releases and thru axles follow the same principle. Ceramic bearings go where drivetrain friction matters most, and weight is cut to single-digit grams.
양쪽 크랭크 암을 모두 3D로 조각하듯 깎아, 가벼움과 우아한 선을 함께: Both crank arms are sculpted in 3D, combining lightness with elegant lines. Choose from BSA 68, BB30, PF30, BB86, BB Right and Italian 70mm, in black, silver, purple, gold and red, gold and blue, turquoise and purple, or orange and purple.
속 빈 단면의 5축 CNC 크랭크. 비비를 포함하면 규격에 따라 390: Five-axis CNC cranks with a hollow section. 390 to 416g including bottom bracket depending on standard, 30mm axle.
7075-T6 판재를 깎아 하드 아노다이징한 1x 체인링. 위상을 맞춘: 1x chainring machined from 7075-T6 plate and hard anodized. Phased teeth hold the chain evenly, and mounted reversed it moves the chainline 7mm inboard.
Bottom bracket kit with HyperCeramic bearings. Rust-free, smooth and long lasting. 29mm (DUB) and 30mm axles.
BSA · T47 · PF30 · BB30 외: BSA · T47 · PF30 · BB30 and more
15년 넘게 다듬어 온 풀리. 바퀴마다 스테인리스 세라믹 베어링 두 개를: Pulleys refined for over 15 years. Two stainless ceramic bearings in each wheel keep them stable, at half the weight of competitors.
레버는 다축 3D 가공, 로드는 1300kgf를 견디는 항공 등급 티타늄: Levers machined on multiple axes, and aerospace-grade titanium rods rated to 1300kgf. Four retainers keep the springs from getting lost.
나사 끝에 육각 홈을 낸 가볍고 단단한 스루 액슬. 길이와 나사 피치를: Light, stiff thru axles with a hex groove at the threaded end. Measure the length and thread pitch to choose the model for your fork or frame.
이탈리아 북부의 기술자와 엔지니어가 한 대씩 손으로 만듭니다. 자체 MI: Each frame is made by hand by technicians and engineers in northern Italy, with proprietary MIF (Mirror Internal Finish) tubing and a time-consuming wrapping process. No shortcuts.
플랫 오벌 탑튜브가 핀처럼 헤드튜브로 이어지는 경량 로드 프레임. 크랭크: Lightweight road frame whose flat-oval top tube blends into the head tube like a fin. Crank and fork bearings sit in 7075-T6 CNC fittings.
3년 넘게 개발한 에어로 클라이밍 프레임. 이전보다 강성을 20% 넘게: Aero climbing frame developed over three years. Over 20% stiffer than before while also lighter, with cables hidden by the Hyper ICR headset.
Hubs, stems and wheels
that fit your bike.
허브와 휠은 브레이크 방식과 액슬 규격, 카세트 규격을, 스템은 스티어러: For hubs and wheels, check the brake type, axle standard and cassette standard first. For stems, check steerer diameter, length and angle. Figures follow Extralite's official technical data, with weight tolerance within 1 to 2%.
무게는 허브셋 기준, 따로 적은 것은 단품: Weights are per hubset unless marked as single hub
XD · 마이크로스플라인 · XDR · 시마노 로드 · N3W: XD · Microspline · XDR · Shimano road · N3W
무게는 가장 가벼운 스포크 구성의 앞뒤 세트: Weights are front and rear sets with the lightest spoke option
프리허브는 시마노 HG 로드 11 · 12단, 시마노 마이크로스플라인,: Freehubs are available for Shimano HG road 11 and 12 speed, Shimano Microspline, SRAM XD and XDR, and Campagnolo 11 and 12 speed and N3W, with options varying by hub. Bearing options change the weight by a few grams. At Rubi Workshop we check your frame and match hubs, wheels, stems and cranks together.
From a sub-2kg frame
to a full range of parts.
2kg이 안 되는 풀서스펜션 프레임셋이라는 목표에서 시작해, 스템과 시트: It began with the goal of a full-suspension frameset under 2kg, and grew to stems, seatposts, chainrings, hubs, wheels, cranks and Brompton parts. Over 30 years Extralite has widened what it makes, but never changed how honestly it weighs it.
The first full-suspension frame, the F1.
The Stem with a four-bolt faceplate, The Post seatpost and the F2 SwingLink.
The first Ultra hubs and the UltraLevers brake levers.
HyperFront and HyperRear hubs and the QRC2 crankset.
오프셋 카본 림과 훅리스 림 벽의 CarboCamber29, HyperS: The CarboCamber29 with offset carbon rim and hookless walls, and the HyperSmart hub.
HyperBoost F and R hubs for the Boost standard.
카본 프레임 SCR-058, HyperStem 1.25, UltraPul: The SCR-058 carbon frame, HyperStem 1.25 and UltraPulley.
브롬톤 허브 CyberFront SL-B · CyberRear SL-2B: Brompton hubs CyberFront SL-B and CyberRear SL-2B, HyperStealth and OctaPhase.
QRC-3 · QRC-3S 크랭크, Cyber SPD 3+, HyperS: QRC-3 and QRC-3S cranksets, Cyber SPD 3+ and HyperSmart 3+.
브롬톤 카본 휠 CyberCity 349B, AeroClimb 056s,: The CyberCity 349B Brompton carbon wheels, AeroClimb 056s, HyperBB and Hyper ICR.
